jobs.title: Director, Internal Audit Analytics & Artificial Intelligence
jobs.description:
Location

Brookfield Place - 181 Bay Street

Brookfield Culture

Brookfield has a unique and dynamic culture. We seek team members who have a long-term focus and whose values align with our Attributes of a Brookfield Leader: Entrepreneurial, Collaborative and Disciplined. Brookfield is committed to the development of our people through challenging work assignments and exposure to diverse businesses.

Job Description

Position Summary

The Director, Internal Audit Analytics & Artificial Intelligence leads the Audit Analytics and AI function within Internal Audit, driving the adoption of data analytics, automation and emerging technologies to enhance audit quality, efficiency, and insight generation.

Reporting to the Audit and Analytics SVP, the Director partners closely with audit leaders and business stakeholders, both from Brookfield and Portfolio Companies, to integrate analytics and AI across the audit lifecycle, identify opportunities for innovation, and develop scalable solutions that strengthen the Internal Audit function. This role combines technical expertise with strong leadership, requiring excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Strategy

Lead the continued development and execution of the Internal Audit Analytics & AI strategy and roadmap.
Identify opportunities to expand analytics, automation, and AI across audit engagements.
Lead and develop a high-performing analytics team while fostering collaboration and innovation.
Establish priorities and best practices for analytics and AI within Internal Audit.

Audit Analytics & AI

Lead the integration of analytics throughout the audit lifecycle.
Oversee scalable analytics to identify risks, anomalies, and control weaknesses.
Drive the evaluation and implementation of AI, generative AI, process mining, and intelligent automation.
Promote responsible AI practices aligned with governance expectations.

Stakeholder Collaboration

Partner with audit leadership, Technology, Finance, Risk, and business stakeholders.
Present analytical findings and recommendations to senior management.
Translate technical concepts into clear business insights.

Technology Leadership

Provide technical direction for Power BI, Alteryx, SQL, Python and LLM tools (Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude), including prompt engineering, automation and agents.
Support scalable data architecture and visualization capabilities.

People Leadership

Mentor and develop analytics professionals.
Promote knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
Support capability development.

Qualifications & Experience

Education

Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Accounting or a related field.

Experience

10+ years of progressive experience in Audit Analytics and AI, Digital and AI Transformation.
Experience leading analytics initiatives and managing teams.
Experience presenting insights to senior management.

Leadership Competencies

Strategic thinker with strong business acumen.
Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to influence without direct authority.
Strong project management and organizational skills.
Passion for innovation and emerging technologies.

Position Opening Reason:

Backfill

Brookfield is committed to creating an accessible and inclusive organization. We are committed to providing barrier-free and accessible employment practices in compliance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act. Should you require a Human Rights Code-protected accommodation through any stage of the recruitment process, please make them known when contacted and we will work with you to meet your needs.

jobs.title: Director, Wealth Strategy & Research - 12-month contract - Tangerine
jobs.description:
Requisition ID
: 273102

At Tangerine, we’re redefining banking. As Canada’s leading digital bank, we thrive on innovation, agility, and bold thinking, tackling every challenge head-on with leading technology and the unstoppable power of collaboration.

Our client-obsessed teams deliver flexible, accessible banking solutions, breakthrough products, and award-winning service. Beyond banking, we’re committed to making an impact in the communities we serve and across our organization. We foster a culture built on integrity, inclusion, and fearless ambition – where diverse perspectives are valued, and people are empowered to do their best work.

Are you ready to disrupt the status quo? Do you crave challenges that push boundaries? If you’re a high performer looking to accelerate your career and reimagine the banking landscape, this is your moment.

Let’s shape the future of banking together!

What You Will Be Doing

The Director, Wealth Strategy & Research will lead the development and execution of strategic initiatives that shape the future of our wealth offerings. This role carries enterprise-level accountability, executive decision support, and stakeholder influence across the organization. The Director will serve as a thought leader, driving insights that inform product strategy, market positioning, and long-term growth.

Is this role right for you? In this role, you will be:

Define and execute the Tangerine Wealth product roadmap in alignment with business strategic objectives.
Provide strategic insights and recommendations to senior executives, influencing enterprise priorities and business decisions.
Represent Tangerine Wealth in executive forums and prepare board reports, C-suite briefings, and steering-committee updates.
Work closely with market research and competitive intelligence teams to identify actionable insights to inform product development and business decisions.
Continuously monitor the traditional wealth, digital wealth, and fintech landscape for emerging trends, competitor moves, regulatory developments, and technology innovations.
Translate research findings into actionable strategies that drive innovation and client-centric solutions.
Develop and manage structured frameworks for competitor benchmarking, client segmentation, pricing, and go-to-market strategies.
Build data-driven business cases for new initiatives, products, or partnerships.
Support annual and multi-year strategic planning cycles with market input, scenario analysis, and post-implementation reviews to capture lessons learned.
Establish KPIs, scorecards, and dashboards to track progress against strategic objectives.
Maintain decision-support tools and intelligence repositories for timely stakeholder updates.
Produce thought-leadership pieces, white papers, and briefing notes to inform executives and strengthen external positioning.
Distill complex research and analysis into clear recommendations, dashboards, and strategic presentations for senior leadership.
Build and maintain strong relationships with senior leaders, cross-functional teams, and external partners, and coordinate input for major decisions to ensure alignment between insights, strategy, and execution.
Champion process optimization, knowledge-sharing, and adoption of best practices by creating templates, playbooks, and standardized deliverables for strategy projects.
Lead and develop a high-performing team, fostering collaboration, empowerment, and continuous improvement.
Championing a client- obsessed culture
Leveraging a growth mindset, embracing learning and continuous improvement
Contributing to a dynamic workplace fostering trust, integrity and inclusion
Removing obstacles to drive momentum across teams
Leading a high performing team through times of change
Supporting teams through transformation activities

Skills

Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We'd love to work with you if you have:

AI fluency
A craving to contribute to a high-performing team
Ability to drive results in periods of change
Track record of fostering an inclusive culture
10+ years in strategy, research, corporate development, or management consulting, ideally within financial services or fintech.
Strong quantitative and qualitative research capabilities, with deep expertise in the North American wealth management space.
Proven ability to translate insights into actionable strategies and drive cross-functional alignment.
Excellent executive-level communication and presentation skills, with comfort working under tight deadlines on high-visibility projects.
Highly organized, self-directed, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-changing environment.

What's in it for you?

You will be part of a diverse, inclusive, and purpose driven community of client- obsessed innovators who move fast, push boundaries, and celebrate big together.
We are creating something game changing and you get to make your mark on it.
You will have access to thousands of online and in person learning experiences at your fingertips to elevate your career and accelerate your development.
From competitive benefits to programs that support your wellbeing and financial goals- we invest in you today and in your future.*
Tangerine employees participate in Scotiabank’s pension & benefits programs (available to permanent employees)

Location(s): Canada : Ontario : Toronto

At Tangerine we value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the team, and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment. If you require accommodation during the recruitment and selection process, please let our Recruitment team know.

jobs.title: Embedded GSOC Intelligence Team Leader
jobs.description:
About Sibylline

Sibylline is the world's largest private intelligence firm, helping organisations manage risk, spot opportunity, and build resilience in an increasingly volatile world.

Our people provide the insight that leaders need to navigate today's complex geopolitical landscape. It's meaningful work, with high-profile clients and real-world stakes – and that's what makes it so rewarding.

We're innovative, entrepreneurial, and growing fast, which means genuine opportunities to take on complex challenges, work with cutting-edge technology, and build your career, whatever stage you're at.

Everyone brings something different to the table, and we want that reflected in how we operate. Our roles suit a wide range of working styles, personalities, and interests, and we invest heavily in our managers so that every person gets the support they need to do their best work.

We're looking for people who are ambitious, discreet, and sharp, with strong integrity and a genuine curiosity about the world. If you're comfortable with uncertainty, energised by complex problems, and passionate about global affairs, we'd love to hear from you.

Job Description

Expected Compensation:
C$100,000 – C$125,000 per year

Location:
Onsite, Toronto, ON

PTO:
20 days per annum

Sick:
5 paid days per annum

Vacancy Status:
Existing Vacancy

Position Summary

We are looking for an experienced security and intelligence professional to join us as an embedded GSOC Intelligence Team Leader for a newly established Global Security Operations Centre (GSOC) at a multinational e-commerce client. The GSOC Manager will lead a 24/7/365 team of GSOC Intelligence Analysts providing threat monitoring, incident response, intelligence analysis, and physical security operations.

You will be responsible for leading, managing, and developing the GSOC team. This will include line management, scheduling, identifying training needs and delivering training, and performance management. The Team Leader will also be responsible for setting the standard for high-quality intelligence analysis work and as a power user for all tools and systems used by the GSOC. This role will also involve working closely with Sibylline management and the client to ensure a smooth transition as the new team comes online. You will proactively engage with the client and stakeholders on monitoring and intelligence needs and priorities, and help to scope the output and strategic deliverables of the team.

This is an onsite role at the client’s Toronto office, working Monday to Friday, 9 am - 5 pm. There may be occasional need to work out of hours during emergencies and time-sensitive matters.

Essential Functions / Responsibilities

Drive the implementation of the new GSOC team, identifying the client’s immediate delivery needs and any team training requirements
Set team priorities, delegate tasks, manage deadlines, provide feedback, and ensure high-quality service delivery
Manage the 24/7/365 shift schedule and ensure full shift coverage
Monitor and direct the team’s use of security systems, intelligence and open-source tools
Lead oversight of GSOC’s adherence to incident response, triage, and escalation Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
Provide continuous editorial and mentoring support for the GSOC team
Define and agree on key intelligence priorities with security stakeholders to optimise the production and delivery of intelligence products and briefings
Build and maintain cross-functional stakeholder relationships
Identify process gaps, training gaps, configuration issues, or workflow friction, and implement corrective actions in a timely manner
Display creative thinking and consulting skills to deliver a continually improving service for the client
Other duties as assigned

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Experience, knowledge, and interest in current affairs, international relations and emerging security threats
Advanced research, intelligence gathering and analytical skills, and the ability to write high-quality products and deliver high-impact briefings for a senior security audience
Excellent English written and verbal communication skills, with close attention to detail and strong ability to quality assure (peer review) intelligence products
Excellent time management and prioritisation skills, with the ability to set and meet deadlines and manage own / team’s workload accordingly
Ability to solve complex problems with patience and precision, whilst retaining focus on customer needs
Ability to build rapport, strong and sustainable relationships, and interact with all levels of the client
Ability to develop and deliver training and support direct reports’ professional development

Qualifications

Undergraduate or Postgraduate qualifications in International Security, Intelligence, Risk, Geopolitics or other related disciplines, or equivalent professional experience
Experience with GSOC and intelligence tools, including threat monitoring, OSINT, and SOCMINT platforms
At least 5+ years total experience working in a corporate setting or similar public or private sector environments, with at least 2+ year line management experience
Fluent written and spoken English
Preferred cross-functional experience within a global security team (e.g. threat monitoring, travel security, business continuity, crisis management), particularly in a leadership role

Work Environment/Physical Requirements

This position is moderately self-directed and requires understanding and compliance with company policies, procedures, and values. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to interact collaboratively with the team and stakeholders, and communicate via phone, videophone, or text messaging. The position may require travel up to 5%.

Additional Information

Interview Process

Initial call with our Talent Acquisition team member
Timed written assessment (arranged at a time that suits you) to test writing and analytical capability
Panel interview with some of the team members and hiring managers at Sibylline
Meet and Greet with the client

Artificial Intelligence:
Not used in candidate screening

Research indicates that certain groups are less likely to apply for a position unless they meet every single requirement. If you feel you meet some of the requirements and can offer a unique perspective to this role, we strongly encourage you to apply—you might be the perfect fit we're looking for!

Sibylline is committed to the recruitment and selection of candidates without regard for sexual orientation, gender, ethnicity, age, political beliefs, culture, and lifestyle. We are committed to fostering a business culture that reflects these values and promotes equal opportunity.

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Enterprise Finance Systems
jobs.description:
Opentext - The Information Company

OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.

AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered.

At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We are hiring talent AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.

Your Impact

As Senior Director, Finance Systems within OpenText’s CDO organization, you’ll have the opportunity to shape how technology enables Finance at a global scale. This is a highly visible leadership role where you’ll lead functional and technical teams responsible for Finance systems delivery, operations, and modernization, including SAP on-premises applications and integrated services.

You’ll help drive OpenText’s Finance modernization agenda, including the implementation of S/4HANA Cloud, while partnering with senior Finance and IT leaders to turn business priorities into technology outcomes. You’ll lead through complexity, leverage AI and emerging technologies, and deliver measurable value for Finance teams and business users globally.

What You Will Do

Work closely with senior leaders to understand business objectives and develop the finance systems roadmap.
Responsible for leading the team in the delivery, operational support and continuous improvement of the SAP on-premises applications.
Finance modernization including the implementation of S/4HANA Cloud capabilities and the broader ecosystem of solutions integrated into SAP
Work with Architecture and rest of the peer network to develop and maintain Financial Systems Landscape relevance.
Accountable for delivery of change & bug-fixes for all finance Systems
Accountable for the operational upkeep of the finance systems including SOX and other IT general controls.
Accountable for people agenda for the finance systems team.
Key contributor to the overall technology delivery strategy, ensuring the realization of goals such as reuse, infrastructure simplification, cost management, solution flexibility, operational resilience and the practical use of emerging technologies, including AI, to solve outcome-driven business and IT use cases.
Build strong cross-organizational relationships and effectively influence staff across the business and IT.

What You Are Great At

Building strong relationships and effectively managing expectations with senior stakeholders, business partners, peers, and external vendors.
Breaking down complex business problems into practical technology solutions, including automation and AI, to deliver measurable business and IT outcomes.
Leading effectively in a global operating model, with teams distributed across geographies and organizational structures.
Communicating complex technical and business concepts clearly and effectively to leadership and diverse audiences.
Thinking strategically and critically, developing roadmaps, and translating strategy into execution.
Managing multiple priorities, plans, and budgets in a fast-paced environment while delivering on time and on budget.
Driving best practices, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and a culture of learning across teams.
Building and motivating high-performing teams and fostering an environment of trust, collaboration, and accountability.

What It Takes To Excel

10+ years of experience leading engineering, development, or technology delivery teams.
Strong experience leading complex SAP ERP delivery and operations, including SAP on-premises platforms and integrated Finance systems.
Proven experience leading S/4HANA Cloud implementations, including program delivery, business process transformation, stakeholder alignment, cutover, and post-go-live stabilization.
Strong understanding of complementary financial systems and cross-domain technology ecosystems, including Finance, HR, and CRM.
Experience supporting technology integrations related to Mergers, Acquisitions, and Divestitures (M&A).
Experience leading multiple complex workstreams within a global organization.
High-tech software or technology services industry experience is an asset.
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant discipline, college diploma, or equivalent experience.

One Last Thing:
If you’re a strategic technology leader who thrives on transformation, enjoys solving complex business challenges, and wants to shape the future of Finance technology at a global scale, we’d love to hear from you.

OpenText's commitment to diversity and inclusion surpasses legal requirements, evident in our Equal Employment Opportunity Statement of Policy which promotes a respectful and empowering environment for employees of all backgrounds, culture, national origin, race, color, gender, gender identification, sexual orientation, family status, age, veteran status, disability, religion, or other basis protected by applicable laws.

If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a ticket at Ask HR. Our proactive approach fosters collaboration, innovation, and personal growth, enriching OpenText's vibrant workplace.

Compensation:
At OpenText, we offer a thoughtfully designed benefits package that supports your physical, emotional, and financial wellbeing. As you move through the hiring process, we’re happy to provide more details about our compensation programs, including variable and commission compensation opportunities for eligible roles, vacation entitlement, and paid time off.

Salary Range:
Depending on the candidate’s education, experience, skills, geographical location, and alignment with internal equity and external market, actual salary may vary and be higher or lower than the range posted.

AI Usage Disclosure:
As part of our commitment to transparency, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in various stages of our recruitment process, including resume screening, candidate matching, interview scheduling, and communications. These tools are designed to improve efficiency, reduce bias, and enhance candidate experience. All decisions regarding hiring are made by qualified human professionals, and we continuously monitor our AI systems to ensure fairness and compliance with applicable regulations.

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer
jobs.description:
We have partnered with a newly established CIRO-regulated investment dealer offering Contracts for Differences here in Toronto. We are seeking a hands-on, ambitious CFO to take ownership of the Canadian finance function. This is a unique opportunity to join a start-up operation backed by a global public company and build the finance function from the ground up.

Key Responsibilities:

Own the full finance and accounting function.
Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting.
Oversee CIRO/MFR and other regulatory financial reporting and ensure regulatory compliance.
Manage budgeting, forecasting, cash flow, financial controls, and tax.
Partner with the Canadian CEO and COO on financial and commercial decisions.
Provide reporting and insights to Group Finance and international leadership.
Present financial information to senior leadership, the Board, and regulators.
Manage external auditors, advisors, and other finance partners.
Build scalable finance processes and, over time, help grow the Canadian finance team.

Requirements:

CPA designation required.
Approximately 7+ years of progressive finance/accounting experience.
Strong technical accounting and financial reporting background.
Experience with regulatory reporting, ideally within an investment dealer, capital markets, financial services, or fintech environment.
Public company experience strongly preferred.
Canadian accounting experience required.
Must be comfortable operating as a hands-on, stand-alone finance leader in a start-up environment.
Strong communication and executive presentation skills.

Regulatory Qualifications:

The ideal candidate will already have completed the required CFO and PDO regulatory examinations.

Additional Information:

The Mason Group is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and accessible recruitment process. We welcome applicants from all qualified candidates. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in all stages of the recruitment process, in accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA).

This role is for an immediate vacancy, and we are actively hiring.

Technology-assisted screening tools including AI may be used during the recruitment process; however, all applications are reviewed by our Consultants.

If you are already registered with The Mason Group, please contact your Recruiting Consultant directly with reference to job #21123.
